text:
samir: Quick share 10am number: we crossed 3M ARR for the quarter. not blasting it externally yet, but massive high five to everyone. :tada: Thoughts on a tiny after-hours thing (keep it optional)?
zoe: YES PLEASE. I'm voting boba + stickers. :bubble_tea:
kai: Dumpling cart all the way. also can we get a '3M' enamel pin? tiny flex. :pin:
olga: Remote folks should get a digital sticker pack + a small care-package option. also major kudos to @ops for the seamless scale last week. :clap:
hr-bot: Poll created: Celebration pick  Boba | Dumplings | Rooftop sunrise pastries | Plant raffle. Poll ends in 18h. RSVP link: https://polls.internal/3471112233
ops-bot: Autoscaling alert resolved 03:14 UTC last night. No customer-facing errors. :white_check_mark: Shoutout: @marco and @kai for on-call coverage.
marco: Thanks! Team effort. also can confirm we had extra headroom so nobody had to flip to fallback models.
samir: Cute idea: tiny 'thank you' note cards with everyone's names to drop on desks for in-office folks. remote folks get a digital card and a $10 coffee e-gift.
zoe: I'll design a one-line 'we made this together' Slack background for the remote pack. dropping mock in #design in 2h.
kai: If dumplings win I'm bringing my secret chili oil. label will say 'optional heat: y/n'. :hotsauce:
olga: Can someone run a micro-kudos thread at noon where people drop one sentence for someone who helped? I'll start with ops and cs.
hr-bot: RSVP reminder will be sent tomorrow AM. Please RSVP if you want a physical item. Shipping available for remote.
samir: Love the micro-kudos idea. also small ask: keep it low-perf, low-PR. this is for the team. :heart:
zoe: +1 low-key. See you at the dumpling table (or boba station). :sparkles:
